kebab_example: aliyun ice create-media-live-input --name myinput --type RTMP_PUSH --input-settings FlowId=00000081-9693-40dc-bbab-db5e49000000 SourceUrl=rtmp://domain/app/stream StreamName=mystream SrtPassphrase=srtencryption SrtMaxBitrate=3000000 FlowOutputName=myFlowOutputName SrtLatency=1000 SrtPbKeyLen=16 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateMediaLiveInput

parameters.help_en: The name of the input. Letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (_) are supported. It can be up to 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 输入实例名称。支持英文+数字+英文短划线(-)、下划线(_)。长度限制英文64字符
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The input type. Valid values: RTMP_PUSH, RTMP_PULL, SRT_PUSH, SRT_PULL, and MEDIA_CONNECT
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the security groups to be associated with the input. This parameter is required for PUSH inputs
parameters.help_zh: 要绑定的安全组ID列表，Type为PUSH类型时必填
parameters.name: security_group_ids

fields.help_en: The ID of the flow from MediaConnect. This parameter is required when Type is set to MEDIA_CONNECT
fields.name: flow_id

fields.help_en: The output name of the MediaConnect flow. This parameter is required when Type is set to MEDIA_CONNECT
fields.help_zh: MediaConnect Flow的输出名称，Type为MEDIA_CONNECT时必填
fields.name: flow_output_name

fields.help_en: The source URL from which the stream is pulled. This parameter is required for PULL inputs
fields.help_zh: 拉流的流地址，Type为PULL类型时必填
fields.name: source_url

fields.help_en: The latency of the SRT stream, in milliseconds (ms). Valid values: [100, 10000]. This parameter is optional when Type is SRT_PUSH or SRT_PULL
fields.help_zh: SRT流的延迟，单位ms。取值范围[100, 10000]。Type为SRT_PUSH，SRT_PULL时选填
fields.name: srt_latency

fields.help_en: The maximum bitrate of the SRT stream, in bits per second (bps). Valid values: [100, 100000000]. This parameter is optional when Type is SRT_PUSH or SRT_PULL
fields.help_zh: SRT流的最大码率，单位bps。取值范围[100, 100000000]。Type为SRT_PUSH，SRT_PULL时选填
fields.name: srt_max_bitrate

fields.help_en:
The SRT encryption configuration. The password for the SRT stream consists of 10 to 79 visible ASCII characters. This parameter is optional when Type is SRT_PUSH or SRT_PULL.

If the encryption configuration is not empty, all SRT clients must use the correct password to publish or playback; otherwise, the SRT connection will be denied
fields.help_zh:
SRT加密配置，SRT流的密码，由10~79个ASCII编码可见的字符组成。Type为SRT_PUSH，SRT_PULL时选填。

如果加密配置不为空，则所有 SRT 客户端必须使用正确的密码才能发布或播放，否则 SRT 连接将被拒绝
fields.name: srt_passphrase

fields.help_en: The SRT encryption configuration. The key length for the SRT stream. Valid values: 0, 16, 24, 32. This parameter is optional when Type is SRT_PUSH or SRT_PULL
fields.help_zh: SRT加密配置，SRT流的密钥长度。可选值：0, 16, 24, 32。Type为SRT_PUSH，SRT_PULL时选填
fields.name: srt_pb_key_len

fields.help_en: The name of the pushed stream. This parameter is required for PUSH inputs. It can be up to 255 characters in length
fields.help_zh: 推流的流名称，Type为PUSH类型时必填。长度限制英文255字符
fields.name: stream_name

parameters.help_en: The input settings. An input can have up to two sources: primary and backup sources
parameters.help_zh: 输入设置。最多2个，对应主输入和备输入
parameters.name: input_settings
